purpose: Prospectively evaluate whether a pre-specified PBM response model generalizes to entirely unseen subjects.
scientific_scope: Research validation only; not a treatment-selection, dose-recommendation, diagnostic, or clinical-efficacy protocol.

primary_endpoint.interpretation: Magnitude of the baseline-subtracted HbO response integrated over the pre-specified response window.
primary_endpoint.change_after_lock: not permitted without a new protocol version

design.primary_generalization_test: all observations from held-out subjects remain excluded from model fitting and calibration
design.randomization_or_sham: TBD if this protocol is embedded in an interventional human study
design.blinding: TBD if this protocol is embedded in an interventional human study

pbm_dosimetry.lock_requirement: All stimulation parameters and allowed ranges must be specified from the approved experimental/safety protocol before first prospective subject is enrolled. The software model must not choose them.

measurement.channel_aggregation: mean across included channels as currently implemented by pbm_metrics
measurement.preprocessing_version: pin nlcore commit/tag before protocol lock

covariates.rule: Covariates must be named and encoded before protocol lock. Adding covariates after inspecting prospective outcomes requires a new protocol version.

model.hyperparameter_rule: Freeze before prospective evaluation; no tuning on held-out subjects.

success_criteria.lock_requirement: Numerical thresholds must be justified and frozen before prospective outcome data are inspected.

lock_conditions: ethics/safety framework resolved for any human stimulation study
PBM stimulation parameters and allowed dose range specified
